{{Quote|Sorry about your limo, Jag. Maybe you should find another dealer. You'd think an armored speeder would take a hit better than this.''"<br />"''Crumple zones are part of the design. I assure you, it can take a volley of concussion grenades and still speed away.|Han Solo and Jagged Fel|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
A '''limousine''', often shortened to '''limo''' and alternatively called a '''repulsorlimo''', '''limo-speeder''', or '''hoverlimo''',<ref name="DIRP">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Death Is Remotely Possible|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> was a longer-than-usual [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], usually used by beings of importance. A similar vehicle, the [[groundlimo]], was a [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle]] and not a [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]]. Under [[Supreme Slavelord]] [[Trioculus]], officers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] commonly rode in landspeeder limousines when traveling on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] had one in use in [[43 ABY]], for which [[Baxton]] was the [[Pilot/Legends|driver]]. The limousine was also rather tall, almost completely hiding [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bazel Warv]]&mdash;who had developed an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic psychosis]] and had been subsequently incapacitated atop the limousine&mdash;from view.
